summary: The historical AES implementation does not mix input length into its state, allowing null padding to produce collisions. The fix adds a final AES round incorporating the original length in both 64-bit halves. Reversing that round restores the faulty behavior exercised by the existing padding test, whose shared assertions were updated by this commit. The test uses src/aes_hash.rs and requires an AES-capable x86/x86_64 target with target-feature=+aes. No tests were executed.
